CHANGES
- Rewritten mode descriptions for better clarity

FIXES
- Fixed issue where Game Menu opened after closing Game Mode Select with ESC
- Fixed hover highlight on inactive modes
- Fixed incorrect display of joined player's name

notes.title: New gamemodes and better colors of the interface
notes.content:
Update Notes

New Game Modes:
• One Prompt – Submit a drawing prompt; each player visualizes it in their own way.  
• Workpiece – Start with a base sketch; each player continues it individually.  
• Demonstration – Create a single drawing without any given theme.

Improvements:
• Interface color palette updated to be more visually pleasing.

Fixes:
• Likes are now hidden on your own drawings.
